title: Solid for docs and team notes
text: I've used Notion for project docs and personal notes for a while. Linked databases keep sprint notes and specs in one place without another wiki. Sync is fine across laptop and phone; search gets a bit noisy once the workspace gets big.

title: I find everything in Notion a bit too chaotic
text: I really tried using it and it seems to be capable of a lot but there is simply too much going on and I need to pay to continue using basic features which would have been ok if I did not find the tool so overwhelming.
